description: Replay one of your saved strategies on historical candles and return the summary (trades, win rate, profit factor, drawdown, return, data coverage). Compute, not read-only: it spends compute quota (beta: 5 per day, 1 per minute) and can take up to about 85 seconds. Date range at most 90 days, ending no later than today. A backtest is research, not a forecast, and places no orders.

initial_capital.description: Starting capital in USDT for the replay.

strategy_id.description: Id of one of your strategies (get_my_strategies).

symbol.description: Pair to replay. Required when the strategy lists no symbols; otherwise one of the strategy's symbols (default: its first).

to.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), at most 90 days after from.

name: run_backtest
title: Run backtest
